filter_biases: standard_normal(512) * 0.1, then cast to float32, continuing the same RNG
feature_centering: subtract training feature mean from both training and test features
target_encoding: one versus rest: +1 for the class and -1 otherwise
solver: Jacobi preconditioned conjugate gradient, zero initialization
stopping_rule: exactly 300 iterations for each system, no tolerance or denominator guards
combination: sum of per-example centered score vectors divided by their sample standard deviations (correction=1)
